messages.author: Gard Nelson
messages.body:
Hi all,
I’d like to send pmemd’s output to stdout instead of a file. I noticed that
several programs, including sander, appear to support this behavior by
using “-o stdout” in the command line. However, when I try this with pmemd,
I get a file named stdout.
Is there a way to get the output on the screen?
Thanks!
Gard
